name: Cascade Biotech Pathogen-Containment Suit
description:
A Level-4 biological containment suit designed for handling the most dangerous known pathogens. The suit is completely self-contained with a 6-hour air supply, maintains positive internal pressure, and features an integrated chemical shower port for decontamination before removal. The exterior surface is impregnated with broad-spectrum antimicrobial compounds.

Used in Cascade Biotech's highest-classification research facilities and deployed during biological contamination events. The suit's transparent face panel is reinforced — not against impact, but against the psychological pressure of working face-to-face with organisms that would use your body as food.
functionality: BSL-4 pathogen containment, 6-hour air, integrated decontamination, positive pressure
what_it_says: What you're working with would consume humanity if it escaped, and this suit is the containment protocol.
story_hooks: A Pathogen-Containment Suit's air supply logs show it was used for 14 hours — well beyond its rated 6 — in a facility that should have been empty, suggesting someone was trapped inside for far longer than any operation should have lasted.

physical_description.visual_profile: A full-body containment cocoon with an imposing, clinical presence. The suit creates an almost alien silhouette—bulbous at the torso where the air recycling system sits, tapered at the limbs. The transparent face panel dominates, a large curved window that exposes the wearer's eyes and upper face while the rest of the head disappears into sealed material. Institutional and sterile, yet oddly intimate.
physical_description.fit: Compression-adjacent but intentionally loose through the torso to accommodate internal circulation systems and emergency equipment. Sealed and articulated at wrists and ankles with double-lock friction-fit gaskets. The suit moves with the body but never quite comfortable—always aware of the barrier between skin and world.
physical_description.primary_material: Multilayer ballistic-grade synthetic composite with interwoven antimicrobial polymer threads. Exterior impregnated with silver-ion and broad-spectrum enzymatic compounds. Inner liner is breathable technical mesh treated with moisture-wicking polymer.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, almost slick to the touch on the exterior—like touching a sealed medical instrument. The antimicrobial coating creates a subtle tackiness. Subtle horizontal quilting throughout reinforces structural integrity. The transparent face panel is optically clear but noticeably thick, with a faint amber tint from protective UV filtering.
physical_description.color_scheme: Surgical white as primary, with high-visibility safety yellow accent striping down the sides of the legs and across the shoulders. The face panel has a faint amber/citrine tint. Interior lining visible through wrist seals is pale medical blue. Small red biohazard symbols printed at the collarbone and on both sleeves.
closures: Full-body magnetic seal system running down the front centerline
Double-lock friction-fit wrist and ankle gaskets with indicator tabs
Helmet visor secured via quarter-turn pressure locks
Umbilical connector port at the hip for external air supply redundancy
distinctive_features: Oversized transparent reinforced face panel that curves from forehead to chin
Integrated chemical shower decontamination port at the right hip (recessed, sealed)
Dual air inlet filters visible as raised domes at shoulders
Internal pressure monitoring window (small green/red indicator at upper left chest)
Reinforced palm and finger grips in contrasting matte grey
Serial number and biohazard certification etched into wrist cuff
Wear patterns: scuffed right forearm (lab bench contact), faint discoloration at cuffs from sweat/chemical exposure
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 corporate. This is institutional wealth—only available through Cascade Biotech employment or high-level government contract. The suit's value exceeds most street-tier annual income.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by Cascade Biotech's pathogen research division, deployed during biological containment events in the GLMZ, and occasionally seen in specialized medical/crisis response teams. Wearing this signals either deep corporate security clearance or involvement in biocontainment protocols. It's a suit that erases the person wearing it, reducing them to function.
physical_description.condition_typical: Usually pristine in storage, but field-deployed suits show specific wear: scuffed exterior, faint stains from decontamination chemical runoff, stress marks at the gaskets, possible small abrasions on the face panel from emergency procedures. Between uses, they're treated with antimicrobial renewal protocols.
